architecture.mechanism: rank difference accumulation waveform similarity algorithm
architecture.intervention: Implement a sensor array on the transmission gear train to capture vibration waveforms, apply the rank difference accumulation algorithm to calculate the maximum mismatch degree between current and baseline data, and use 5G communication to transmit transient characteristic differences for real-time fault isolation before catastrophic noise occurs.
architecture.expected_effect: Significant reduction in the influence of abnormal vibration data on similarity judgment, enabling reliable detection of power train anomalies despite signal noise or weak output conditions.
architecture.falsification_test: Inject synthetic abnormal noise into transmission vibration sensor data streams while simulating weak output conditions; verify if the algorithm correctly distinguishes between normal operational variance and the specific failure mode associated with Recall 236 without triggering misoperation.
